title: Wheeltop EDS TX  Ican Graro | engineer inspection| cheap gravel combo First Look
disclosure: Hambini says in the video that ICAN sent the frame free of charge and that Wheeltop supplied the EDS groupset; the description links ICAN and a groupset store.
summary: Engineer-style inspection of a 54 cm Graro with weighed parts, thread and facing checks, bottom-bracket alignment measurement and a borescope look inside the frame and fork. Findings cover unfaced brake mounts and paint in the T47 threads, not ride quality.
